summary: Frontend-only verification of the two additive content updates (5-poster Graphic Design gallery with captions, and Muar Coffee Table Book deliverable with 6 captioned pages). All 5 requested feature areas PASS. Selected Work still has exactly 3 project cards; Graphic Design shows 5 captioned posters (01 Coffee, 02 Onitsuka Tiger, 03 Automotive Photo Manipulation, 04 Sneaker, 05 Hoodie) with all images loaded (naturalWidth 1080/1080/1170/1080/1089); Muar shows COFFEE TABLE BOOK section (data-testid coffee-table-book) with category 'Editorial & Publication Design', description, and 6 loaded page images (/muar-book/page1,2,5,6,8,14.png, naturalWidth 1007) each with a caption; Muar overview contains 'cultural identity, history, and heritage of Muar'; project-video present and photo gallery has 3 images. Book does NOT appear as a top-level card nor in Graphic Design / Video projects. Video Editing regression: 5 video cards (video-project-1..5 + watch-video-1..5) intact, modal closes via project-detail-close. Zero console/page errors. No horizontal overflow at 1920x1080 or 390x844. Asset HTTP checks: hoodie JPG 200, all 6 book PNGs 200.

issues: With 5 items the balanced column layout leaves a tall empty area in the right column below '05 — Hoodie Advertisement'. Cosmetic only; consider column-fill: auto or an odd-count-aware layout if tighter packing is desired.

critical_code_review_comments: ProjectDetail.jsx poster/book figures use loading="lazy" — expected, but automated tests must scroll the modal before asserting naturalWidth (documented for next agent).
Book page images are large (0.9-1.5 MB PNGs, ~6.2 MB total). Consider WebP/compressed variants for load performance on the Muar detail page.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static portfolio SPA; content lives in src/data/portfolio.js. Project cards use data-testid project-open-{id}; modal close is project-detail-close. Poster captions render as 'NN — Title' + meta in figcaption; book section testid is coffee-table-book. Images are lazy-loaded inside the modal, so scroll (page.mouse.wheel loop) before checking naturalWidth. Everything in iteration 6 scope passed; no open defects other than one cosmetic masonry whitespace note.
rca_of_the_issue: No defects found; both content updates were implemented additively and render correctly.
